description: Meesters, Johannes and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The released macro-enabled spreadsheet extends SimpleBox with an aquatic-persistence dashboard. It calculates how long a chemical remains in the water phase while degradation and transport operate across regional, continental and global compartments. The accompanying report gives sensitivity analyses of volatility and air-water partitioning, and PROMISCES model-train guidance places this screening in surface-water and drinking-water exposure assessment. It does not replace a site-specific bank-filtration model. The deposited dashboard has CC-BY terms, while the general SimpleBox repository is labelled GPL; identical licensing across all components is not asserted. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
